description: Calculates a deterministic invoice preview without saving, charging, sending, or creating an invoice. Use to preview invoice in the connected business. Returns document_type, customer_id, pricing, persisted, charged, sent, scope.

coupon_code.description: Optional coupon code evaluated by the authorized pricing service.

customer_id.description: Resolved customer ID; required for an invoice preview.

document_discount_type.description: Document-wide discount mode: none, percentage, or fixed.

document_discount_value.description: Document-wide discount amount or percentage for the selected discount mode.

tax_mode.description: Tax calculation mode: none or manual.

tax_rate_id.description: Business-owned tax rate identifier for manual tax calculation.

name: preview-invoice

charged.description: Charged flag; previews do not perform this action.

customer_id.description: Customer id for the returned result.

persisted.description: Persisted flag; previews do not perform this action.

pricing.description: Pricing data returned by the authorized safe projection.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

sent.description: Sent flag; previews do not perform this action.

title: Preview Invoice Tool
